$comment: The Z Watch — multi-product stock & sale watcher (files keep the legacy
'zfc' names on purpose; see docs/zfc/README.md).
EVERY url is null on purpose. This file was written in a sandbox that
cannot reach www.nikonusa.com, so no URL here could be verified and none
was invented. The checker refuses to guess: a null url is reported as a
loud configuration error, never as 'out of stock'.
THE Z f COLOUR LIST IS UNVERIFIED. The plain black body is safe; the
premium-exterior colours below are a best recollection and were never
checked against Nikon. Delete the ones that do not exist, add the ones
that do, and only then paste URLs.
ALERT INTENTS: each product declares what it wants to be told about.
restock     -> fire when a variant becomes in_stock (and when its very
first reading is already in_stock)
price_drop  -> fire when the price is strictly lower than last time
parse_broken is NOT listed anywhere: it fires for every product,
always, because a blind watcher is always news.
The Z f is watched for price drops only. It is normally in stock, so a
restock intent would fire a pointless alert on the very first run and
every time it blinks in and out of stock. Its stock is still recorded
and still shown on the page — it just never pings.
TO FINISH SETUP: open each colour's product page on nikonusa.com, copy
the address bar, and paste it into the matching 'url' below. Remove any
variant Nikon no longer sells; add any this list is missing.
See docs/zfc/README.md for the full walkthrough.
pollNotes: Scheduled every 15 minutes by .github/workflows/zfc-watch.yml. GitHub's cron is best-effort and runs late under load — treat the cadence as 'about every 15 minutes', not a guarantee. Requests are made one at a time with requestDelayMs between them, with an honest User-Agent, and robots.txt is fetched and obeyed before any product page is touched. A handful of requests per quarter-hour against a large retailer is a rounding error on their traffic; if that ever stops being true, raise the cron interval rather than adding parallelism.
userAgent: zfc-watch/1.0 (personal Nikon Z fc / Z f stock checker, a few requests every 15 min; +https://github.com/sky121/sky121.github.io)
